The '''Vatha sector''' was a sector located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the Galaxy]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Copperline]] and [[Edatha]].

==History==
The sector was represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by [[Krall Praget]].
